title: Spark Join Mechanics
description: Intermediate path through Spark's join layer: broadcast vs sort-merge selection, predicting output row counts, diagnosing double-counting from one-to-many joins, and spotting the ambiguous-column and hint-override failures that bite in production.
outcomes: You'll select the right join strategy, predict row counts through one-to-many joins, catch double-counting before it corrupts metrics, and debug the AnalysisException and hint-override surprises that appear only at scale.
